`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md` (751 lines, v2.0, authored by Vega)

Wire success/warning/danger/info with subtle/default/emphasis triads. Separate `--color-accent` from `--color-secondary`. Add proper dark-mode sidebar tokens. During scan, show a **terminal-style streaming log panel** (left: 7-step vertical checklist, right: live log lines with timestamps). Use `<pre>` + monospace for the log. Streaming can be mocked with setInterval for now — just the UI shell. This is the differentiating move from Nova's research.

- No TODOs left behind

- Dark mode works on EVERY page — no `bg-white` or `bg-slate-*` raw usages anywhere in `app/` or `components/`
- `globals.css` is the single source of color truth

## Do NOT
- Do NOT delete functional components without replacement
- Do NOT rename routes or break URL structure
- Do NOT touch `supabase/`, `middleware.ts`, `lib/supabase/*`, `lib/score-utils.ts`, `lib/constants.ts` business logic
- Do NOT touch `next.config.ts`, `railway.json`, `nixpacks.toml`
- Do NOT add new dependencies beyond what's in `package.json` — cmdk, framer-motion, shadcn primitives, sonner, lucide-react, recharts are all already installed

## When done
- Report what you changed (file list + summary)
- Report `pnpm typecheck` output (should be clean)
- Report `pnpm build` output (should succeed)
- Note any deferred items that couldn't be done in this pass

This is a large ticket — estimate 30+ file edits. Be thorough. Quality over speed.
